records.rule: reply Qxb2 is a capture; net material -3 (before your move) at the end of Stockfish's line (10 plies), -3 vs its best line
records.explanation: Rd8 hung material: you end -3 in material. In Stockfish's lines, Qc1 (+6.1) keeps the material level; your Rd8 (-2.6) loses a bishop. Qc1 protects the rook on d1 and the bishop on b2. Your Rd8 pins the rook on e8 to the king; Stockfish answers Qxb2, which takes the bishop on b2 and attacks the knight on b1.
